llm_response.reason: The website mimics the structure, legal notices, and product categories of a well-known e-commerce site (Lazada), presents extremely low prices and large prize claims (triggering urgency and psychological appeal), lacks legitimate business information or contacts, redirects all action links (including registration, promotions, live chat) to a suspicious external website unrelated to any legitimate payment processor, hides ownership in WHOIS records, and encourages downloads that can be malicious.
